data.description:
discovered-from:LP-0MVK3KIPZ002SR32

## Problem

tests/test_start_proxy_mode.sh fails before running any assertion: it extracts fixture values from proxy/config-cheap.yaml / proxy/config-fast.yaml, which no longer exist (the fast/cheap mode axis was removed by LP-0MVDT94F0003VHUA, priority-based routing). It is not referenced by any pytest wrapper or CI job, so the breakage is invisible to the default suite.

## Impact

Dead harness for a removed feature: it cannot validate anything today and gives a false sense of mode coverage. Discovered while updating the sibling harnesses with --foreground for LP-0MVK3KIPZ002SR32 (detach-by-default launch).

## Proposed fix

Either delete the harness (the mode axis is gone) or rewrite it to assert the priority-routing config resolution that replaced fast/cheap.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] tests/test_start_proxy_mode.sh either no longer exists, or runs green and asserts behaviour of an existing feature (no references to removed config-fast.yaml / config-cheap.yaml).
- [ ] No other test/harness references the removed mode configs.

Implementation complete in the worktree (detach-by-default launch). Session ID: 01a165e7-1488-7335-8d68-c9d7cddcaac4 - /home/rgardler/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-rgardler-projects-llm-.worklog-worktrees-wl-LP-0MVK3KIPZ002SR32-detach-by-default-launch-in-start-proxy--/2026-10-22T23-16-45-321Z_01a165e7-1488-7335-8d68-c9d7cddcaac4.jsonl

Changes:
- proxy/scripts/start-proxy.sh: --foreground / START_PROXY_FOREGROUND=1 and --log-file <path> parsing (consumed, never forwarded to uvicorn), usage-header docs, and the launch helper. Default path re-execs the same script with --foreground (dropping --restart) under setsid (nohup + disown fallback), child stdio to the log file (default /tmp/proxy-startup.log), then one handoff line (child PID + log path + curl /health) and exit 0. Foreground path keeps today's blocking exec; the uvicorn argv is unchanged. An unusable log destination fails fast.
- tests/test_start_proxy_detach_shell.py: strict xfail marker removed (GREEN).
- tests/test_start_proxy_keys.sh, tests/test_start_proxy_mode.sh (run_proxy / run_script / run_restart), proxy/scripts/test_start_proxy_port_in_use.sh: --foreground added where the final exec is intercepted or a stray real launch must stay reap-able.
- tests/test_start_proxy_launch_modes.py (new, suite-collected): --foreground and START_PROXY_FOREGROUND=1 keep the blocking exec and are not forwarded; default detaches with exactly one handoff line; the detached re-exec does not repeat the restart phase; an unwritable --log-file fails fast; usage header documents both flags and the env opt-in.

Evidence (run in the worktree): bash -n clean on all five scripts; tests/test_start_proxy_detach.sh 15/15; tests/test_start_proxy_keys.sh 37/37; tests/test_start_proxy_restart_gate.sh 3/3; proxy/scripts/test_start_proxy_port_in_use.sh passes; tests/test_start_proxy_launch_modes.py 6/6; tests/test_start_proxy_detach_shell.py green.

Caveats:
- tests/test_start_proxy_mode.sh still fails at fixture extraction because it reads proxy/config-fast.yaml, removed by LP-0MVDT94F0003VHUA. Pre-existing on dev and not in the default suite; filed as discovered-from LP-0MVK6JQW9003KY29 rather than fixed inline (out of scope here).
- The changed-scope selector ignores untracked files, so the new pytest module was verified with a targeted run; the dev-push pre-push hook runs the full suite at this commit.
